newsitem.title: USA: Mountasia seeks acquisitions, no 97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Mountasia seeks acquisitions, no 97 profit.

text.p: Mountasia Entertainment International Inc said on Wednesday it does not expect to return to profitability in 1997 and that it is seeking additional capital resources to fund its 1997 capital expenditures.
The company said the expenditures are part of a new business plan designed to return its operations to profitability.

To fulfil its plan, the company said it would have to issue additional debt or equity securities or consider possible changes in its capitalisation or structure, including the pursuit of potential acquisitions.
The company said it does not expect material charges against its existing asset base in 1997 because of this.
Early Wednesday the company reported a fourth-quarter loss of $1.41 after charges, compared to a year-ago loss of $0.77.
